# Vendored libraries: drawing world

| Library | Version | Source | Licence | File |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| rough.js | 4.6.6 | https://github.com/rough-stuff/rough (npm: roughjs) | MIT, Copyright (c) 2019 Preet Shihn | rough.mjs |

rough.mjs is a single ES module produced with `npx esbuild --bundle --format=esm` from the npm package `roughjs`.
It draws the hand-drawn crayon look of the Drawing tab. The licence text is in the header of the file.
